fusions.name: Puffball Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps down on spore caps, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rot-Shod Blow
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Spore-Laid Track
fusions.desc: Lays a 6-tile strip of spores on the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Enemies crossing it are [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Overnight Growth
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
